claims.proposition: The export restrictions at issue in the WTO rare-earths disputes had been fully removed by 20 May 2015.

evidence.statement: The WTO Secretariat recorded China's statement that export duties, export quotas and specified trading-right restrictions on rare earths, tungsten and molybdenum had been removed.
The WTO Secretariat also recorded a U.S. concern that an export licensing requirement remained.
